mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_score (exam_id, student_id, total_score, pass_status, rank_position, submit_time, grade_time, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{examId}, #{studentId}, #{totalScore}, #{passStatus}, #{rankPosition}, #{submitTime}, #{gradeTime}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_score SET total_score = #{totalScore}, pass_status = #{passStatus}, rank_position = #{rankPosition}, submit_time = #{submitTime}, grade_time = #{gradeTime}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE score_id = #{scoreId}
